result.summary: Found 1 major visual issue: the delivery time text under Tokumaru Ramen Bar appears garbled and unreadable due to missing or collapsed spacing/characters.

issues.description: Under the 'Tokumaru Ramen Bar' card, the delivery info text appears broken as '25-35ndelivery • Ramen' instead of clearly readable text such as '25-35 min • delivery • Ramen'. The 'min' portion appears missing, collapsed, or overlapped, making the label hard to read.
issues.suggestion: Fix the text layout by ensuring proper spacing and character rendering between the delivery time ('25-35 min') and the 'delivery' label, or use separate styled elements to avoid overlap.
